tools.name: plc_ide_export_active
tools.description: Save and export the attested active normal imported solution through the pinned Sysmac runtime. Provide process identity from runtime_status and the solution GUID/storage_folder from list_projects. Destination must be a new local SMC2 path outside the persistence folder and on the same drive. The export uses native command rules and may show a normal Sysmac prompt; it refuses file mode, AutoConnect, changed identities, suppressed saves, persistence IO errors, and existing output paths. Publishes only a readable SMC2 copy; no PLC connection or download.

tools.name: plc_ide_runtime_status

tools.name: plc_ide_rebuild_active
tools.description: Rebuild the active offline NX controller only if the process start, solution and controller identities still match runtime_status. Requires UAC. Return correlated completion, native result and compiler diagnostics; timeout is unknown and never retried. Does not import, save or connect to a PLC.

Returns solution GUIDs and process start identity for open_existing, including from the start page. Does not import, open, save or compile a project; storage folders are IDE locations, not source archive paths.

tools.name: plc_ide_open_existing
tools.description: Open one persisted Sysmac project by the GUID returned by list_projects. Requires normal UAC, the same process start and an idle empty start page. Preserves vendor permission/availability checks and requires matching completion event plus final solution identity. Does not close another project, import/overwrite/delete, save, compile or operate a PLC. Timeout remains unknown without automatic retry.

tools.name: plc_ide_close_active
tools.description: Close only the expected active normal imported Sysmac solution. Requires normal Windows UAC, the same process-start and solution identities, a completed native editor flush, and a clean model. Refuses file mode, AutoConnect, save suppression, dirty state, importing, or changed context. Uses the normal UserCloseSolution command once and requires matching close events plus a later empty-solution snapshot; never answers save prompts. Timeout remains unknown without retry. Does not save, export, compile, import, or operate a PLC.

tools.name: plc_validate
tools.description: Validate staged models with bounded ST lexer/delimiter and scalar checks, built-in integer literal range checks, and missing VAR_EXTERNAL reports. Check complete native DataType tables for empty STRUCTs and missing explicit byte offsets in OffsetType=User structures; BOOL members also require a bit offset. Automatic NJ/CJ offsets are not diagnosed. Scan Ladder for unsupported instructions. Function calls, members, arrays, enums, unions, references, library types, full ST grammar, Ladder semantics, DataType layout calculation, and Sysmac build remain outside this partial analysis; coverage is returned explicitly.

tools.name: plc_preview_iec_xml_import
tools.description: Preview PLCopen ST POUs, simple global variables, structures, unions, named DINT enumerations, fixed one-dimensional array aliases, nested DataType namespaces, and up to 1000 ordered LD rungs. Array aliases are expanded inline in variable and structure member types; they are not registered as named native DataTypes. Structures use Sysmac's automatic NJ member layout. PLCopen DataType namespaces are flattened into the selected native table's flat symbol scope; references to imported namespaced types are rewritten, and duplicate names after flattening are rejected. Each rung must be linear or have one two-path split/join, NO/NC contacts, and one standard final coil; multi-rung files require unique explicit evaluationOrder values. Nested branches, negated coils, complex LD, variable-length/multidimensional arrays, structured initial values, namespaced POUs, and namespace comments remain blocked. New data types must fit completely observed native DataType tables; pass data_type_table_id when the project has multiple tables. All edits stay in the local transaction; no staging or Sysmac action occurs.

tools.name: plc_stage_iec_xml_import
tools.description: Stage a previously previewed PLCopen ST/linear-LD import with simple global variables and supported structures, unions, named DINT enumerations, fixed one-dimensional array aliases, and nested DataType namespaces flattened into the selected native table's flat symbol scope. Array aliases are expanded inline in variable and structure member types; they are not registered as named native DataTypes. Structures use Sysmac's automatic NJ member layout. Qualified references to imported types are rewritten and duplicate names after flattening are rejected. Pass the same DataType table entity ID used in preview when the project has multiple tables. Unsupported namespaced POUs, namespace comments, nested/complex LD, variable-length or multidimensional arrays, and structured initial values remain blocked. Source hash, table selection, plan, templates, project revision and staged snapshot must still match; commit and IDE build remain separate.
